theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a B2B circular textile marketplace, trust, sustainability, and physical materiality are paramount. The design must feel grounded, tactile, and transparent—avoiding clinical 'SaaS' coldness or excessive 'fintech' gloss.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#1A231E]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#1A231E]
rules.notes: Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Satoshi' for authoritative yet approachable B2B headings. Use 'Work Sans' for clear tabular data and body text.

rules.tinting: Never use pure grayscale. All grays must be tinted with a warm earthy hue (e.g., #4A5043).
rules.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Brand primary (#2E4D3A) should only be used for high-emphasis actions.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs to give the dense B2B data breathing room.

bento_grid.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical balance.
bento_grid.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Dense, data-heavy, but perfectly aligned.

surface_strategies.cards_and_widgets: Flat solid background (`bg-white`), crisp 1px border (`border-[#EAE6DF]`), minimal rounded corners (`rounded-lg`). No muddy drop shadows. On hover, use a slight lift (`-translate-y-1`) and subtle ambient shadow (`shadow-md`).
surface_strategies.header: Solid background (`bg-[#F9F8F6]/95`), backdrop blur (`backdrop-blur-sm`), 1px bottom border. Do NOT use transparent headers over images without gradient overlays.
surface_strategies.inputs: Flat, sharp borders (`border-[#EAE6DF]`), subtle focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2E4D3A]/20`).

chat_ui_guidelines.structure: Vinted-style real-time layout. Two-pane layout on desktop (List on left, Conversation on right). Full-screen thread on mobile.

bubbles.buyer_left: bg-white border border-[#EAE6DF] text-[#1A231E] rounded-2xl rounded-bl-sm

chat_ui_guidelines.ai_assist_button: Prominent floating or inline button in the input area. Style: `bg-[#C06A4A] text-white hover:bg-[#A85B3F] rounded-full px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2 shadow-sm`. Text: 'Spark AI Assist'.
chat_ui_guidelines.negotiation_cards: Use structured cards within the chat for formal offers (e.g., 'Offer: $1.20/kg for 5000kg'). Style these as distinctly separated bento blocks inside the chat stream.

buttons.primary: bg-[#2E4D3A] text-white hover:bg-[#22392B] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#2E4D3A] text-[#2E4D3A] hover:bg-[#2E4D3A]/5 rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#C06A4A] text-white hover:bg-[#A85B3F] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

badges.certification: bg-[#F0EBE1] text-[#2E4D3A] text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded border border-[#EAE6DF]
badges.origin: bg-white border border-[#EAE6DF] text-[#4A5043] text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded

components.tables: Shadcn tables customized with `border-[#EAE6DF]` headers, alternating soft row backgrounds (`even:bg-[#F9F8F6]`), and right-aligned numeric data.

hero_background.description: Sunlight shining through a cotton field at sunrise.
hero_background.usage: Landing page hero section background. MUST use a gradient overlay (bg-black/30) to ensure text readability.

investor_logistics.description: Aerial shot of colorful shipping containers.
investor_logistics.usage: Investor page or 'Global Reach' section on the landing page.

dashboard_texture.description: Detailed close-up of a light beige woven textile.
dashboard_texture.usage: Subtle background texture for the CRC token page or specific feature cards. Lower opacity to 10%.

product_raw_cotton.description: A field of cotton plants with white bolls.
product_raw_cotton.usage: Product listing thumbnail placeholder for raw cotton.

product_recycled_fabric.description: Intricate blue and white woven fabric.
product_recycled_fabric.usage: Product listing thumbnail placeholder for recycled fabrics.

avatar_seller.description: Confident businessman posing in modern office.
avatar_seller.usage: Seller profile picture in the chat UI and listing detail page.

avatar_buyer.usage: Buyer profile picture in the chat UI.

pages.landing: Hero with full-bleed cotton field image, massive Satoshi typography. Value prop bento grid for Buyers/Sellers/Investors. CRC token teaser banner.
pages.marketplace: Sidebar filters (Type, Origin, Certs). Main area: 3-column grid of product cards. Product cards emphasize high-quality images and clear typography for MOQ/Price.
pages.listing_detail: Split layout: Sticky left column for large product gallery. Scrollable right column for specs, certifications, seller info, and 'Contact Seller' primary CTA.
pages.create_listing: Multi-step form utilizing Shadcn Form primitives. Clean, wizard-style flow. Focus on uploading certifications and defining Incoterms.
pages.chat: Full height layout (`h-[calc(100vh-header)]`). Left sidebar for message threads. Main area for Vinted-style chat. Sticky top header with listing summary. Sticky bottom input with AI assist trigger.
pages.profile: Verification badge prominent. Tabbed layout for 'Active Listings', 'Reviews', 'Company Info'.
pages.crc_token: Editorial layout. Use the beige woven texture background. Clear data visualizations (Shadcn Charts) showing token utility and ecosystem rewards.
pages.dashboard: Strict bento grid (Mode B). 'Control Room' for tracking active negotiations, listing views, and CRC token balance.

icons.usage: Use simple, line-based icons. Maintain stroke-width 1.5 or 2 for clarity.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="contact-seller-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the marketing landing page structure.
Use Shadcn components for all forms, modals, tables, and the dashboard.
DO NOT use 'Inter' font. Import and configure 'Satoshi' and 'Work Sans'.
Implement the Chat UI using the specific bubble styles defined in `chat_ui_guidelines`. Ensure the AI Assist button stands out using the Terracotta accent color.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. ONLY use the provided `media_urls`.
